# House of Eyeglasses

> Online eyewear store in the United States. Designer eyeglasses frames from 150+ brands, new and in stock, with prescription lenses made to the customer's prescription. Free shipping in the USA, delivered in 5–10 business days. An optician checks every prescription before the lab starts. Unworn non-prescription frames can be returned within 30 days.

Every frame has its own page with brand, model, color code, size in millimetres, price in US dollars and availability. Prices shown are for the frame; prescription lenses are added in four short steps on the frame's page. The site is in English with a Spanish version of every text (EN | ES).

## Guides
- [How to Read an Eyeglass Prescription: What the Numbers Mean](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/receta.html): How to read an eyeglass prescription: what OD, OS, OU, SPH, CYL, AXIS, ADD, prism and PD mean, a free sign checker that stays on your device, and how to measure your PD at home.
- [Measure Your PD Online](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/pd.html): Measure your pupillary distance (PD) online with your camera, or with a ruler and a mirror. Free, no app, and no photo leaves your device. Single and dual PD. The camera measurement runs in the browser with two rulers (the iris and the proportions of the face); it gives the distance PD to about ±2.5 mm for an adult, ±3 mm for a child.
- [Lens Options](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/lentes.html): Compare lens types, materials and coatings, see who each one is for, and find the right lens thickness for your prescription.
- [Find Your Fit: Frame Size Guide](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/talla.html): Work out your frame size from the three numbers on the glasses you own, or measure your face with a card. Standard or low nose bridge, and the frame shapes that suit your face.
- [Style Quiz](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/quiz.html): Six quick questions to find the frame shapes, materials, colors and lenses that suit you. No sign-up needed.
- [Glasses for Your Face Shape](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/face-shape-guide.html): How to choose glasses for your face shape: round, square, heart, oval or long, with the frame shapes that flatter each one and every shape in stock. One page per face shape: round, square, heart, oval and long.

## Eye care guides (general information with links to their official sources: FDA, AAO, AOA, NEI, FTC, CDC; they do not replace an eye exam, and the store does not do eye exams)
- [Signs You Need Glasses (and What to Do Next)](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/signs-you-need-glasses.html): Signs you need glasses: blurry vision, squinting, eye strain, headaches, glare or halos and trouble seeing at night. What each sign points to, when not to wait, and how to get a prescription.
- [How Often Should You Get an Eye Exam?](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/how-often-eye-exam.html): How often to get an eye exam, by age and risk: the schedules of the American Optometric Association and the American Academy of Ophthalmology for adults and children, and when to go sooner.
- [How Long Is an Eyeglass Prescription Valid?](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/how-long-is-a-prescription-valid.html): How long is an eyeglass prescription valid? Usually one or two years, set by state law and your eye doctor. Where to find the date, your right to a copy under the FTC Eyeglass Rule, and the contact lens rules.
- [Nearsighted vs Farsighted: What Your Prescription Means](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/nearsighted-vs-farsighted.html): Nearsighted vs farsighted: a minus SPH means nearsighted, a plus SPH means farsighted. What each one is, how presbyopia and the ADD fit in, real prescription examples and which lenses to choose.
- [Glasses for Astigmatism: Lenses and Frames That Work](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/glasses-for-astigmatism.html): Glasses for astigmatism: what CYL and AXIS mean, which lenses to choose (single vision, progressive, high-index, anti-reflective) and how to pick a frame that keeps the correction in place.
- [How Much Do Prescription Glasses Cost Online?](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/prescription-glasses-cost.html): How much prescription glasses cost online at House of Eyeglasses: the frame price plus the lenses, with today’s lens prices and three example totals (single vision, progressive, high-index). Free U.S. shipping.
- [Contact Lenses vs Glasses: Pros, Cons and Cost](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/contacts-vs-glasses.html): Contact lenses vs glasses: what each one does well, the fitting, prescription and care contacts need, and how the costs compare over time. Plain facts from the FDA, the FTC and eye doctors.
- [Do You Still Need Glasses After LASIK?](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/glasses-after-lasik.html): Do you still need glasses after LASIK? Often for reading after 40, sometimes for a small leftover prescription or for night driving. What the FDA and eye doctors say, and what to ask your surgeon.
